title: The Pullman estate's corner elm stands on a clear, slender trunk
items: The elm on 18th Street's south parkway at the Calumet Avenue corner, across from the Pullman stable, now rises as one slender trunk clear to about 5 m before its branches start, as Taylor's two photographs of the estate show it. It had been drawn as a stout, full-grown elm forking low into a V.
